risks.description: Production cost is capped at twelve and a half Euros, which rules out expensive features such as building a small television into the remote

notes: The finance briefing states a twenty-five Euro selling price, a fifty million Euro profit aim and an international focus. None is a decision: they are constraints the project manager reports, not things this meeting settles -- the same call made in tiron-ES2004a-c01 for the same price, kept consistent deliberately. The cost cap is recorded as a risk because it is stated as a threat to what the team may design, matching the budget risk recorded in tiron-ES2004a-c02.
